programmes.d: Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.

Emma thinks she’s going to get a promotion at the juice bar but Ash is given the job. Emma and Ash clash over the job, but we discover it’s over a lot more. Meanwhile, Lewis stands up to Charlotte over spending time with Cleo.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
Zyro and his friends battle bladers at the DNA headquarters.
Shinobu defeats Baihu. Shinobu, Zyro and Maru find Gingka.
Kira and Zyro battle in a floating stadium. As the battle rages, a robotized Doji enters and interrupts the match.
Gingka, Zyro and Kira team up to defeat Doji, and the WBBA wins the right to chart the course for the future of Beyblade.
Gingka finds a bey to replace Storm Pegasus and is challenged to a battle by new blader, Masamune.
Masamune refuses to accept a defeat by Gingka and trains hard to finally beat him.
Everyone is fed up with Sabrina and Gem's constant rivalry. Sabrina casts a spell to make Gem and herself closer. But she uses too much potion and it causes them to stick together.
Sabrina makes a dreambike for Harvey, so he can beat the bully Slugloaf. Unfortunately the bike, Sheba, takes on a life of it's own with the intention of Winning no matter what.
Sabrina uses a little dash of mojo to win a bake off contest against Gem. Unfortunately whoever eats her upside down cake has their personality reversed.
Sabrina needs a little lesson in true love for her Shakespeare play. While Zelda just needs a date. They conjure up Romeo to teach them the ropes.
Sabrina is excited when her father drops in for a visit. She's disappointed to find that her father has brought along with him his fiancie.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Day the Earth Moved
programmes.d: Giant, toothy-mawed worms the size of freight trains are plowing beneath the grounds of an old section of Riverdale, eating cars, buildings and anything they can detect moving on the surface.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Dance of the Killer Bees
programmes.d: Humanoid bee creatures begin causing trouble for the people of Riverdale after their leader, the Queen Bee, decides to make the attic of Riverdale High her new hive.
Betty and the rest of the gang rescue Gleebo, a cute little alien who has crash-landed in Riverdale while trying to escape from two ugly aliens.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programmes.d: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.

Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life. Rikki sees Sophie kissing Zane at the event and breaks off their relationship.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Queen for a Day
programmes.d: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the café. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers. Sophie seizes on the problem and looks to fire Bella and the band.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Jewel Thief
programmes.d: The girls discover the Mako crystals contain immense energy and need to mount a rescue mission when Zane jealously steals one in an effort to gain Rikki's attention.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mako Masters
programmes.d: The girls sit their final school exams and have to avoid a water attack in public when the full moon rises early. They confront the water force in the Moon Pool and are given a message about Mako Island.
Marshall and Simon are startled by a creepy kid who's living in an old mill that's haunted by the ghost of Eerie's worst bank robber ever.
Trickery makes Marshall the new Harvest King, and he finds the king's traditional task no treat: he must venture to see the Eerie Wolf, which turns out to be a werewolf.
When Eight-year-old Mary Anne moves to a new neighborhood, she meets two boys who don't know the meaning of kindness.
Fourteen year old Erin has little else to do in her small town than to make up stories.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.

Someone is vandalizing the school. Meanwhile, Kasimir is behaving VERY strangely towards everyone, including Gus and Verne. A rift begins to form between them to the point that Gus would rather hang with the twins than Kasimir.

Guest teacher Master wizard Valentine dazzles the students with his wizardry. And after class he entices Cassy and Gus with tales of the Tear of Moolana.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.

Grandma's long-time foe, Zazu, places a curse on the family, which turns anyone the Howards touch into a werewolf. Zazu agrees to lift the curse if Scott can give her an old photograph of her and his grandparents.
Scott has to watch over Grandpa for the weekend while Grandma is out of town, but it's the same weekend as the school picnic. Grandpa tags along with Scott and his friends, leaving Scott embarrassed.

The werewolf mascot costume is stolen by the uppity Upson High boys, right before the big game. Scott and Stiles must outsmart the snobbish Upson boys in order to retrieve the costume, or they'll have to find a new mascot entirely.
Archie and Jughead get locked in the Riverdale museum with a mummy inexplicably determined to get revenge against our boy hero.
When practical joker Reggie scares Archie with a Wolfman mask, his prank backfires!

'Pantherobics': In order to get on a TV show, Pinky goes through a rigorous training routine with a gruff, old personal trainer. 'Pinkenstein': A love-struck Witch is after our hero who builds a Panther look-alike Frankenstein to distract her.

'Pinky....He Delivers': A modern Red Riding Hood hires Pinky to deliver a mysterious goodie to Grandmother's house, which is under water. 'Super Pink's Egg-celent Adventure': Super Pink rescues the World's Largest Egg from a mad Sumo Chef.
During a fair in his honor, Sonic's shoes are stolen and he and Tails use detective intellect to try and solve the whodunit case.
Tails adopts a squishy creature from another dimension named Goobster, who turns out to be a black hole.
Intent on destroying Inspector Gadget, Dr. Claw lures him with a rash of small crimes and plans on a major one to end the Inspector's meddling once and for all.
Chief Quimby, Penny, and Inspector Gadget rescue the secret computer parts from the clutches of M.A.D., as they race through a high-speed chase aboard a train.
Mr. Bean wants a smartphone but they’re too expensive especially when you can build your own! Mr. Bean is keen to own a brand new smartphone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do.

Mr. Bean has some unexpected guests who think he runs a hotel! A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr. Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise.

Mr. Bean goes in search of wildlife, but he isn’t expecting to see anything prehistoric! Mr. Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox, a bird, a dinosaur!
Mr. Bean has to look after an injured Mrs. Wicket, whose demands start to become a pain. Mr. Bean accidentally causes Mrs. Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair.

Mr. Bean ends up on stage at the opera house...in a dress! Mr. Bean’s car has broken down and he is late to meet Irma for a night at the opera. Mr. Bean finally arrives, but he is refused entry to the theatre because of his filthy attire.
When convicted fraud artist, Howard Hawkins is released on parole, he swears revenge on the men who put him in prison Rip and Cyril!

A trip to New Orleans to purchase The Evil Eye, a rare voodoo artifact, results in the Voodoo Museum's curator being turned into a zombie by a High Priestess who attempts to prevent the sale from going through.
